## Change

Explain the problem and the resulting behaviour. Keep one purpose per PR.

## Evidence

Record the checks that ran, with their results. For UI changes, include screenshots and the affected routes, widths and interaction states from the styleguide.

## Release impact

Describe environment changes or backend dependencies, and how to roll back. State any incomplete verification, including external form delivery.

- [ ] I reviewed the full diff, including any AI-generated code.
- [ ] Required checks pass for the latest commit.
- [ ] No credentials, private member information or generated `dist/` changes are included.
- [ ] One repository admin reviewed and authorized the latest commit, including through an intentional merge of their own PR.
